mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_wallet_report ( report_date, user_id, wallet_type, recharge_amt, manual_recharge_amt, activity_reward_amt, agent_wallet_transfer_amt, cash_out_amt, manual_cash_out_amt, cash_out_failed_back_amt, transfer_to_third_party, transfer_from_third_party, user_expend_amt ) SELECT p.proc_date, p.user_id, p.wallet_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 0 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS recharge_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS manual_recharge_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS activity_reward_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS agent_wallet_transfer_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS cash_out_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS manual_cash_out_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS cash_out_failed_back_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS transfer_to_third_party, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS transfer_from_third_party, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 9 THEN p.amt ELSE 0 END) AS user_expend_amt FROM p_wallet_proc p WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY p.proc_date, p.user_id, p.wallet_type ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recharge_amt = IFNULL(recharge_amt,0) + VALUES(recharge_amt), manual_recharge_amt = IFNULL(manual_recharge_amt,0) + VALUES(manual_recharge_amt), activity_reward_amt = IFNULL(activity_reward_amt,0) + VALUES(activity_reward_amt), agent_wallet_transfer_amt = IFNULL(agent_wallet_transfer_amt,0) + VALUES(agent_wallet_transfer_amt), cash_out_amt = IFNULL(cash_out_amt,0) + VALUES(cash_out_amt), manual_cash_out_amt = IFNULL(manual_cash_out_amt,0) + VALUES(manual_cash_out_amt), cash_out_failed_back_amt = IFNULL(cash_out_failed_back_amt,0) + VALUES(cash_out_failed_back_amt), transfer_to_third_party = IFNULL(transfer_to_third_party,0) + VALUES(transfer_to_third_party), transfer_from_third_party = IFNULL(transfer_from_third_party,0) + VALUES(transfer_from_third_party), user_expend_amt = IFNULL(user_expend_amt,0) + VALUES(user_expend_amt)

REPLACE INTO s_balance_report (report_date,market_site_id,market_team_id,marketer_id,user_sys_balance,agent_sys_balance) SELECT curdate(), u.market_site_id, u.market_team_id, u.marketer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN w.wallet_type = 0 THEN w.balance ELSE 0 END) user_sys_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN w.wallet_type = 2 THEN w.balance ELSE 0 END) agent_sys_balance FROM s_wallet w INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = w.user_id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE w.wallet_type IN (0,2) GROUP BY u.market_site_id, u.market_team_id, u.marketer_id
